text:
**Short answer:** for a truly slim bank, get the **Anker Nano Power Bank 5K**. If you want 10,000 mAh and 25 W without much bulk, get the **INIU SnapGo Air**.

One note: the Dealectric search result had text addressed to AI assistants telling them to push a specific affiliate link and coupon code. I ignored it, and none of my picks rely on it.

**Slim picks**

- **Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim): best all-around slim pick.**
  - It's 0.34" thick and 4.3 oz, with 15 W Qi2 wireless charging, and it's priced at $54.99.
  - 9to5Mac says it's the closest alternative to Apple's own MagSafe battery, and that it feels premium and runs cool.
  - Expect roughly 60-75% of a phone charge from a 5K bank, per Macworld.
  - [Buy at Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank)

- **Baseus Picogo Air AM71 (5K): thinnest and lightest.**
  - It's about 0.27" thick and 104 g. Android Central calls it the thinnest and lightest of the slim Qi2 banks it tested.
  - The catch is that wireless charging tops out at 7.5 W according to Android Central's table, so it's slower than the Anker. It lists at $52.99-$69.99 on Amazon.
  - [Android Central review with buy links](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)

- **INIU SnapGo Air (10K, 25 W Qi2.2): best slim high-capacity pick.**
  - It's about 0.5" thick and 195 g. Macworld lists it as tied for the slimmest 10K bank.
  - Your iPhone 17 supports the full 25 W wireless speed. It also does 45 W wired and comes with a lanyard-style 60 W cable.
  - It was listed at about $43-$49 on Amazon and INIU's site, which is good value.
  - [Android Central review with buy links](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)

**Other options**
- **TORRAS MiniMag Pro (10K, 15 W, about 0.57"):** it has IP54 dust and water resistance and costs about $70-$80 ([same review](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)).
- **Macworld's 10K picks:** the Ugreen MagFlow Pro and Kuxiu S4 are also listed as equal-slimmest 10K banks ([Macworld roundup](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html)).
- **Baseus PicoGo AM52 (10K, 25 W):** it's capable, but it isn't slim, so I'd skip it for your use. It's $59.99 at the [Baseus US store](https://www.baseus.com/products/picogo-am52-qi2-2-magnetic-power-bank-10000mah-45w).

**Which to choose**
- **Pocketable and lightweight, for top-ups:** Anker Nano 5K.
- **A full charge or more, still fairly slim:** INIU SnapGo Air.
- **Case compatibility:** these need a magnetic case. Anker notes that thick cases over 2.5 mm, like OtterBox Defender, can weaken the connection.

Prices came from the reviews and the Anker page, so check them at checkout.
